[NSTG.2.2.2] **Hit / miss.** On a hit the engine returns its stored
value to the rule as JSON-text (usable anywhere a String is,
IDSP.7.7). On a miss the read yields `null` (absent, [LSTO.4.3.1a]) —
it renders `""` under interpolation and propagates in a comparison; a
miss is never an error, and never `DS_ERR_STORAGE_NOT_FOUND`.
